entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber connected at +221
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber cashed. Facing Tyler Mahle, he went deep in the 7th in his 4th at bat. The call: "Kyle Schwarber homers (42) on a fly ball to right field." Final line: 1-for-3 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Justin Foscue came close
entries.story: Justin Foscue went 1-for-4 with 2 RBI against Ian Seymour and the Tampa Bay Rays. Closest call was a double in the 4th: "Justin Foscue doubles (12) on a line drive to right fielder Victor Mesa Jr. Logan O'Hoppe scores. Ezequiel Duran scores. Corey Seager to 3rd." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Rafael Devers stayed in the yard
entries.story: Rafael Devers went 1-for-4 against Christian Scott and the New York Mets. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 3 times.

entries.headline: Hunter Goodman stayed in the yard
